Name: ResetDayButton
Author: radialene
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Introduces a keybind to reset the current Stardew day.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Basically a quick way to quit and reload the current save, primarily useful for minmaxing. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Default keybind is `End` and shows a confirmation dialog before executing. Both of these can be configured.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into `Stardew Valley/Mods`[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Required:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size][/color][/*]
[/list]Optional:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url][/*]
[/list]
